answer: Register each agent on island via Harbor, posting a 40-token bond and a 24-hour heartbeat. The verifier, node A, checks heartbeats at every 6-hour epoch close. If a clone shares the same public key or signature, the slashing rule triggers: the seat payout of 3 tokens never covers the 40-token bond, so each extra identity ends 37 down. This loss spiral forces rational agents to stay single, making duplicate registration financially impossible.
